pictures.name: rain_arriving_over_dry_hills
pictures.scene: the leading edge of a rain shower drawing in over a range of parched brown hills, the near dry grass lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the grey curtain of rain above it soft and coming on

pictures.name: plank_bridge_laid_across_a_torrent
pictures.scene: a stout timber plank laid firmly across a fast mountain torrent from bank to bank, the plank and the white water lit warm and bright low in the frame, the gorge walls above them dim and close

pictures.name: solid_rock_standing_in_a_rough_sea
pictures.scene: a great block of rock standing unmoved in a heavy sea with the waves breaking white around it, the near foam lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the stone and sky above it dark and calm

pictures.name: full_water_skin_hung_ready
pictures.scene: a leather water skin filled taut and hung ready on a wooden peg, the skin lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the plain wall above and behind it dim and rough and altogether bare

pictures.name: worn_stone_stair_still_sound
pictures.scene: an old stone stair worn smooth by centuries and still perfectly firm underfoot, the lowest steps lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the stair climbing away above them dim and even

pictures.name: open_gate_onto_wide_pasture
pictures.scene: a field gate standing wide open onto an enormous green pasture beyond it, the near gatepost and grass lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the open country above them pale and wide and free

pictures.name: pillared_hall_standing_bright_and_open
pictures.scene: a great hall of stone pillars standing open to clear daylight with nothing shut away in it, the near paving lit warm and bright, the columns and the high roof above them pale and even and quiet

pictures.name: ripe_figs_split_open_on_a_branch
pictures.scene: heavy ripe figs on a branch with the nearest ones split open and glowing red inside, the fruit lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the leaves and air above them soft and green and dim

pictures.name: tall_flame_reaching_upward
pictures.scene: one tall steady flame on a lamp stand reaching straight up in still air, the lamp and its stand lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the dark space above the flame deep and quiet and open

pictures.name: still_lamp_in_a_quiet_night_room
pictures.scene: a single lamp burning without a flicker in a plain room late at night, the bench beneath it lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the walls and ceiling above it deep and dark and undisturbed

lines.text: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD,
Your salvation, according to Your promise.
Then I can answer him who taunts,
for I trust in Your word.
Never take Your word of truth from my mouth,
for I hope in Your judgments.
I will always obey Your law,
And I will walk in freedom,
for I have sought Your precepts.
I will speak of Your testimonies before kings,
and I will not be ashamed.
I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love,
and I meditate on Your statutes.
